seoDescription: Contact Ojobo Agbo Eje about an AI initiative, transformation or implementation role, speaking event, or collaboration.
text_002: Let's work on the right problem
text_003: Building an AI initiative, hiring for transformation or implementation, planning an event, or exploring a collaboration? Tell me what you’re working toward.
text_004: Tell me what you are working on
text_005: A short note is enough: the outcome you want, who it affects, what you have tried, and any timeline that matters. I will use it to understand whether and how I can help.
text_008: I also welcome product partnerships, research collaborations, and conversations about roles that need strategy, data science, capability building, and hands-on delivery.
text_011: Tell me about the work you want to redesign and the outcome you need.
text_014: Share the problem, intended users, data, and what a useful solution would enable.
text_017: Tell me who the learners are and what they should be able to do differently.
text_020: Include the event, audience, date, format, and the question you want explored.
